blurb: Guests can play on a 9-hole golf course designed by Rees Jones, practice at a driving range and short game facility, and take private or group golf lessons and clinics. The course is located minutes from downtown Atlanta and offers a clubhouse with a golf shop and limited food and beverage. Various golf programs and junior camps are available.
